answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism like the "Weighted Majority Voting" can be employed to prevent fake-identity attacks. This mechanism assigns unique weights to each agent's vote, with more influential agents having heavier weights. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities will create a ripple effect, but the weighted voting system will discount their votes, rendering them as insignificant as a willow tree in a storm. As a result, the network will remain a stable haven, immune to Sybil attacks and able to function as intended.
